description: A podcast show — the channel-level details Apple Podcasts, Spotify and the open directories read. Create the collection as a Single Object Collection; episodes live in a separate collection built from the podcast-episode schema.
formgrid:
id id
title feedUrl
author ownerEmail
description description
cover cover

---Optional---

id.label: Show ID
id.help: A unique ID for this show. No spaces or special characters. For a Single Object Collection this is the collection id.

title.label: Show Title
title.help: The name of the podcast as it appears in apps.

description.label: Description
description.help: What the show is about. Plain text — this becomes the feed description and the iTunes summary (up to 4000 characters).

author.label: Author
author.help: The person or organisation credited as the show's author. Required by Apple.

ownerEmail.label: Owner Email
ownerEmail.help: Where Apple and Spotify send ownership notices and verification codes. Never shown in apps. Required by Apple.

cover.label: Cover Art
cover.help: Square artwork between 1400×1400 and 3000×3000 pixels, JPG or PNG. Apple rejects anything else. Required.

feedUrl.label: Feed URL
feedUrl.help: The public URL of this show's feed, e.g. https://example.com/podcast.xml. Apps re-fetch with it and the show's permanent identifier is derived from it — set it once and do not change it.

categories.label: Categories
categories.help: Apple's category list. A show can have several; the first is the primary category shown in directories.

mcp.description: Apple Podcasts categories as canonical strings ('Technology' or 'Business > Entrepreneurship'). The first entry is the primary category.

explicit.label: Explicit Content
explicit.help: Tick if any episode contains explicit language or adult content. Required by Apple either way.

type.label: Show Type
type.help: Episodic shows are listened to in any order (newest first). Serial shows are meant to be heard in order (oldest first).

fundingUrl.label: Funding URL
fundingUrl.help: Optional. A page where listeners can support the show; apps that read the Podcast Index namespace show it as a button.

fundingTitle.label: Funding Button Text
fundingTitle.help: Optional. The label for the funding link, e.g. "Support the show".

locked.label: Locked
locked.help: Tell directories that this feed must not be imported into another hosting platform without contacting the owner email.

newFeedUrl.label: New Feed URL
newFeedUrl.help: Only when the feed is moving: the URL apps should switch to. Leave blank otherwise.

guid.label: Podcast GUID
guid.help: Leave blank unless you are migrating a show that already has a Podcast Index GUID. When blank it is derived from the feed URL and must then never change.

created.label: Date Created
created.help: The date the show record was created

updated.label: Date Updated
updated.help: The date the show record was last updated
